package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

	Name string `json:"name"`
}

type T struct{}

func (T) GetUser(_ context.Context) (User, int, error) { return User{}, 0, nil }
